import MilneLib.Sheaf.InvariantModuleSheaf
import MilneLib.Sheaf.GaloisModuleSections
import MilneLib.Sheaf.AffineChartSections
import MilneLib.Sheaf.QuasicoherentRestriction
import MilneLib.Affine.StableAffineSections
import MilneLib.Quotient.GaloisQuotient

/-!
# Effective affine pullback for a linearized quasicoherent sheaf

On a stable affine chart, the invariant module formed from the actual sheaf
sections gives a native sheaf on the fixed section algebra.  Its pullback to
the chart recovers the original restricted sheaf.  The comparison is obtained
by composing module descent, the affine chart section equivalence, and the
quasi-coherent tilde counit.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
open MilneLib.StableGroupAction.ModuleLinearization

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.IsSeparated]
  {act : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X}
  (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
  (hact : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (act g).hom ≫ p = p ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
  {F : X.Modules} (D : ModuleLinearization act F)
  (i : StableAffineOpen act)
  [F.IsQuasicoherent]

local notation "pK" => p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
local notation "hK" => galois_action_comp_base act p hact
local notation "R" => X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op i.U)
local notation "M" => F.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op i.U)
local notation "A" => FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)

/-- The invariant sheaf of actual sections pulls back to the original sheaf on
the stable affine chart.  The fixed algebra is the invariant subalgebra of the
chart's section ring, and the pullback is along its canonical inclusion. -/
noncomputable def linearizedInvariantSheafPullbackIso :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
    letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction i.stable
    letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass i.stable
    letI := moduleSectionsModule pK F i.U
    letI := moduleSectionsModule p F i.U
    letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower pK F i.U
    letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower p F i.U
    letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower_base K L F i.U p
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A R)))).obj
      (tilde (ModuleCat.of (CommRingCat.of A)
        (invariantModule K L R M))) ≅
      F.restrict i.affine.fromSpec := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
  letI := moduleSectionsModule pK F i.U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule p F i.U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower pK F i.U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower p F i.U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower_base K L F i.U p
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction i.stable
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass i.stable
  let E := F.restrict i.affine.fromSpec
  letI := isQuasicoherent_restrict_of_isOpenImmersion i.affine.fromSpec F
  letI : IsIso E.fromTildeΓ := isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_quasicoherent E
  let eM := affineChartSectionsEquiv F i.affine
  let e : ModuleCat.of (CommRingCat.of R) (Γ(E, ⊤)) ≅
      ModuleCat.of (CommRingCat.of R) M :=
    eM.toModuleIso
  exact GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.invariantModuleTildePullbackIso K L R M ≪≫
    (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).mapIso e.symm ≪≫
    asIso E.fromTildeΓ

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen
